$comment: confidence: 'verified' = corroborated against a source during curation. 'draft' = written from reading knowledge and awaiting a pass against the book. `npm run content:check` prints every draft beat as a work queue.

entities.name: Carl
entities.tagline: Coast Guard veteran, competent with his hands, angry in a slow and useful way.

beats.headline: Goes outside at the worst possible moment
beats.text: At three in the morning in January he leaves his Seattle apartment in a t-shirt, boxer shorts and no shoes to catch his ex-girlfriend's cat. Ninety seconds later every man-made structure on Earth collapses and everyone indoors dies. It is the only reason he is alive.

beats.headline: Barefoot, permanently
beats.text: The dungeon takes his entry condition and makes it a rule he can never undo. It should be a crippling handicap. Because this is a television programme, it becomes his brand.

beats.headline: Stops fighting rooms and starts reading them
beats.text: The Iron Tangle cannot be beaten by any one crawler. Solving it takes hundreds of people coordinating at once — the exact thing production is designed to prevent. Carl works out that his real weapon is not explosives. It is organising people.

beats.headline: Stops playing to survive
beats.text: After Signet, he stops treating the dungeon as a gauntlet to be endured and starts treating it as an institution to be destroyed. From here everything he does has two audiences: the one watching the show, and the one he is quietly recruiting.

beats.headline: Commands an army
beats.text: He takes one of the nine factions on the ninth floor and fights a thirty-day war for the castle at Larracos. The book is logistics, diplomacy and atrocity at scale — and it works.

relations.note: The Royal Court, such as it is.

entities.name: Princess Donut
aka: Princess Donut the Queen Anne Chonk
entities.tagline: Award-winning Persian show cat, made sapient by a biscuit. Vain, imperious, genuinely powerful.

beats.headline: The Enhanced Pet Biscuit
beats.text: She eats one and wakes up articulate. Her class is Former Child Actor, which sounds like a joke and is not — it makes her the breakout star of a galaxy-wide broadcast within hours.

beats.headline: Commands people as pieces
beats.text: On the card floor she comes into real power, commanding Alpha Carl and Shi Maria. The book keeps pressing on the question underneath it: what does it mean to own someone you can put in a deck?

beats.headline: Becomes a political instrument
beats.text: By Faction Wars she is no longer a mascot with a spell list. She is a public figure the factions have to negotiate with, and the Princess Posse runs supply and diplomacy alongside the fighting.

relations.note: Mount, pet, and her single greatest source of pride.

entities.name: Mongo
entities.tagline: Donut's dinosaur. Mount, pet, weapon, and the thing she is proudest of in the world.

beats.headline: Joins the Royal Court
beats.text: He completes the party on the second floor, and the three of them descend as the Royal Court of Princess Donut.

beats.headline: Finishes Maggie My
beats.text: When the Scree parasite lunges for Carl, Mongo kills it.

beats.headline: Nearly dies, and becomes a father
beats.text: He is very nearly lost on the ninth floor and is pulled out by Ser Rendelgor. He ends the book a parent.

entities.name: Mordecai
entities.tagline: The alien they hire to explain the rules — and a crawler himself, once.

beats.headline: Hired as a guide
beats.text: He teaches Carl and Donut the mechanics the production would rather they picked up too late to use, and stays as Donut's manager.

beats.headline: He has done this before
beats.text: Mordecai was a crawler on an earlier season — one his own world did not survive. He is not a tutorial NPC. He is a survivor of the same machine.

beats.headline: The past stops being backstory
beats.text: Odette's price for her help is the truth about an old catastrophe involving Huanxin, Mordecai and Uzzi.

entities.name: Katia
entities.tagline: Icelandic art professor whose race lets her reshape her own body.

beats.headline: Becomes a fixture
beats.text: She settles into the party as its tank, and gradually into the series as its most quietly capable fighter.

beats.headline: Comes into her own
beats.text: The Iron Tangle is where she stops being someone Carl protects.

beats.headline: The Crown threatens to turn her
beats.text: The Crown of the Sepsis Whore puts her on course for a forced fight against Donut.

beats.headline: Takes the Orchid boon and leaves
beats.text: At the end of Faction Wars she uses the Orchid boon to exit the dungeon entirely — restored to human, and missing parts of herself.

entities.name: Signet
entities.tagline: An Ink Marauder, and the character through whom the series stops treating NPCs as scenery.

beats.headline: The Ink Marauders
beats.text: Her history exposes what the dungeon does to the populations it calls non-player characters: farming them across generations, with memory carrying between seasons.

beats.headline: Sacrifice and liberation
beats.text: Her arc ends in sacrifice. It is the loss that turns Carl from surviving the game to breaking it.

entities.name: Prepotente
entities.tagline: A profane, opera-singing goat. Exactly as good as that sounds.

beats.headline: Left carrying on
beats.text: Miriam Dom's vampirism finally kills her, leaving Prepotente and Bianca to continue without her.

entities.name: Frank Q & Maggie My
entities.tagline: Two crawlers who worked out early that murdering humans in safe rooms beats fighting monsters.

beats.headline: Safe rooms are not morally neutral
beats.text: They are the first proof that the dungeon's worst hazard is the other survivors, and that production is delighted to broadcast it.

beats.headline: The Scree parasite
beats.text: Maggie returns riding another crawler, Chris; Frank dies of it. Carl extracts her, she lunges for him, and Mongo finishes it.

entities.name: Lucia Mar
entities.tagline: A crawler whose presence gets steadily harder to explain away.

beats.headline: She is carrying 120,000 children
beats.text: The end of Faction Wars reveals that her body contains more than 120,000 human children. Nobody has yet said what for.
